comment: Data representations Aurora DSQL cannot report. PostgREST reads them from
pg_cast: an implicit, function-backed cast between a domain and json/text
(SchemaCache.hs dataRepresentations). DSQL rejects CREATE CAST, so the 15
casts upstream's schema.sql defines are dropped at load time (see the
`cast` entries in load-report.json) while all the cast functions load
fine. This manifest is the substitute, the same way relationships.json is
the substitute for the foreign keys DSQL cannot store: the engine takes
catalog rows first and only fills pairs the catalog did not report.
text -> isodate is absent on purpose: upstream's schema.sql:3093 has that
CREATE CAST commented out and QuerySpec asserts the un-parsed behaviour.
